verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents user-side deletion of one data type: memories can be manually added, edited or deleted under Settings > Personalization > Memory. Because it is self-hosted and built to run entirely offline, data stays on the operator's infrastructure. Nothing in the evidence covers retention policies or deletion of chats, files and other data. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or auto-expiry, deletion of chat history, files and accounts, admin-level purge controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories by navigating to: Settings > Personalization > Memory
